instant.$description: Press and toggle feedback — the tier a control uses to answer the pointer. Below this a change reads as a jump.

fast.$description: Small state changes — a chevron, a disclosure, a menu or overlay opening.

base.$description: Fades, progress strokes and travelling indicators; a sheet or drawer closing.

slow.$description: A large surface arriving — sheet or drawer open.

slower.$description: Reserved for loop periods. Not a transition tier.

linear.$description: Constant speed — loops and panels whose position tracks a value, never a state change.

standard.$description: Symmetric state change in place — selection, colour, a control moving between two rest positions.

enter.$description: Decelerate — an element entering the screen or a surface opening should settle.

exit.$description: Accelerate — an element leaving the screen or a surface closing should get out of the way.

emphasized.$description: Expressive — rare, attention-carrying travel such as a selection indicator moving between items. Use sparingly.
